USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Mary Ryan
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0106 | mary.ryan@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Pricing analyst at a consumer goods distributor serving grocery, convenience and hardware accounts, after two years in sales reporting at an office supply company. Prepares price change files, margin summaries and Power BI reports for account managers and regional sales leaders. Comfortable with SQL for day to day pulls and with Excel for most of the modeling.

EXPERIENCE
Pricing Analyst | Ridgeworth Brands Distribution, Columbus, OH | Nov 2022 to Present
• Prepare customer price files and margin impact summaries in Excel for annual list price increases, each covering several thousand SKUs.
• Maintain a Power BI report comparing realized price against planned price by customer tier, used by account managers in the central and east regions.
• Pull invoice and allowance data with SQL for the senior pricing analyst's margin leakage work, and check totals against the general ledger before each monthly update.
• Ran a before and after comparison of volume on paper goods following a 2023 price increase, which suggested private label items held volume better than forecast.
• Merged duplicate ship-to records in the pricing system after tracing a few margin reporting errors back to the customer hierarchy.
• Answer pricing questions from account managers about contract terms, rebate eligibility and order history, usually the same or next day.
• Keep the pricing team's shared calendar of planned price actions and send a short weekly note on upcoming changes to the customer service team.
• Reviewed promotional allowance end dates against invoice data each month and sent exceptions to billing, a check that caught several allowances still applied after expiry.
• Built a small Excel model that estimates the margin effect of a proposed freight surcharge by customer size band, used once in 2024 planning.
• Updated a set of legacy pricing queries to point at new Snowflake tables after the company moved off its old reporting server.

Sales Reporting Associate | Penderby Office Supply, Columbus, OH | Jul 2020 to Oct 2022
• Prepared weekly sales and gross margin reports by branch and product line for a 60 person sales team.
• Automated part of the monthly commission data pull with Power Query, shortening a three day process to about a day and a half.
• Answered order history questions from sales reps with simple SQL Server queries.
• Built an Excel tracker for vendor cost increases that showed the sales team which customer contracts needed repricing first.
• Cleaned branch and rep codes in the sales file each month so regional totals matched finance.
• Kept the product line mapping table current as new items were added, so margin by line stayed consistent from month to month.
• Pulled monthly sales by customer for the credit team when accounts were flagged for late payment.
• Assembled the quarterly branch ranking packet for the sales director from Excel exports.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2020

SKILLS
SQL: Snowflake, SQL Server, joins, aggregations, basic CTEs
BI and spreadsheets: Power BI (report pages, basic DAX), advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, scenario models)
Analysis: before and after price comparisons, margin bridges, rebate accruals
Tools: SharePoint, Salesforce reports, SAP order history extracts

ADDITIONAL
• Attends a quarterly Columbus analytics meetup focused on reporting and warehouse modeling

ASSISTANT:
{"score": 92, "decision": "ADVANCE", "reason": "Mary has over 4 years of relevant data analyst experience using SQL, Power BI, and Snowflake to deliver margin, pricing, and sales reporting within the retail/distribution space, matching all core requirements and location."}
